tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed ro langs brgyad skor rwa lugs kyi dbang gi rgyud pa la nang mchod 'bul ba'i tshigs bcad bzhugs so// rdo rje 'chang dang gshin rje'i gshed/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro la li ta/ /don yod rdo rje 'byung gnas sbas/ /padma badzra mar me mdzad/ /rdo rje grags dang chos rab dang / /ye shes seng ge 'bum seng zhabs/ /dbang phyug grags dang shes rab dpal/ /'gro mgon 'phags pa zhang ston dang / /brag phug pa dang bsod nams mtshan/ /byang chub dpal bzang ye shes zhabs/ /kun dga' bzang po paṇṭi ta/ /mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub dang / /rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen sogs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams la/ /mchod par 'bul lo oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /myos byed stong gi sogs/ gzhan yang rgyud sde bzhi yi lha/ /rang lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / /chos skyong dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /mkha' 'gro lha srin sde brgyad dang / gzhi bdag rigs drug thams cad kyang / zag med bdud rtsis mchod pa 'dis/ /ma lus mnyes shing tshim gyur te/ /phrin las 'grub pa'i sdong grogs mdzod/ /gzugs sgra la sogs drug po 'di/ /sogs brjod/ e waṃ// // ༈ /rdo rje nag po chen po phyag gnyis pa'i bstod pa phreng 'dzin bzhugs/ /bishwāmbho dzasd+ya sūrya sphu ṭi ta ki ra ṇa hūm̐ bī dza bhū badzra ka yaṃ/ sna tshogs chu skyes nyi ma la gnas 'od zer rab 'phros hūm̐ gi sa bon las byung rdo rje'i sku/ /daṃṣṭā bhirbam ba pī ṭaṃ bi kṛ ta bha ya ka rā syo gra ro ṣent+ra rā dzaṃ/ drag po'i dbang po rnam par 'gyur zhing mche ba gtsigs pa'i sku ni gdong can gtum po'i rgyal/ /sa byā sa byī a rī ṇāṃ tra pa ya bha ya ka ri kartatri ka pa la dhā ram/ dgra rnams skrag mdzad g.yas dang g.yon pa'i phyag gis gri gug dang ni thod pa 'dzin cing 'jigs byed pa/ /banda ā līḍha pā daṃ tri bhū ba na ku ma tiṃ ni gra haṃ dharm+ma dā naṃ/

g.yas brkyang zhabs kyis blo ngan srid gsum nges par 'dzin zhing chos sbyin mdzad la rtag tu rab 'dud bgyi/ /nā gāṣṭau bhū ṣi tāṅgi tri bhu ba na bi ṣa da lo ka dharm+māṣṭa dhā raṃ/ 'jig rten chos brgyad la sogs so gsum dug sbyin klu brgyad rnams kyi yan lag rnams la rgyan char 'dzin/ /asd+yā laṅka ra aṅgi tri bhu ba na a pa daṃ dzā ti mṛ tyuṃ dzi dhā raṃ/ srid pa gsum gyi 'gro ba'i skye dang 'chi ba las rgyal rus pa'i rgyan gyis dbu dang phyag zhabs spras/ /kartatri ka pā la myaṃ tri bhu ba na sa pa do ṣā ya su dzñā bhi dhā naṃ/ sa gsum skyon gyi tshogs rnams legs par mkhyen nas gcod pa'i gri gug dang ni thod khrag nye bar bsnams/ /piṅgardho ke sha pā shaṃ ku ma ti ga ta dhrikadza yya dā naṃ na mā mi/ dmar ser skra yi zhags pas blo gros ngan pa 'ching mdzad rgyal ba'i snod la gus pas phyag bgyi'o// //kṛṣṇā dzī mū ta mūrt+tiṃ gu ṇa ga ṇa pa ra gaṃ shā sa ne ū pa ka raṃ/ yon tan tshogs kyi pha rol son zhing bstan pa nye bar gnas mdzad sku ni char sprin lta bur gnag tsaṇḍārakā lo ka tā mraṃ dza ga ti da sha di sha sarba dharm+ma pra kā shyaṃ/ phyogs bcu'i skye 'gro kun la chos kyi snang ba rab tu gsal mdzad gtum zhing dmar ba'i nyi 'od can/ /lambaṃ bart+tu la kukṣi swa dza ga ti bā su de bā gra be shaṃ/ mtho ris rol pa'i nor lha mchog gi cha byad bzhin du lto ba zlum zhing legs par rab 'phyang ba/ /kā la kā le dza gatmaṃ bi ga ma bi ma ti tassanma hā kā la bande/ blo gros bral bas dus dang dus min log par 'khyams pa'i 'gro ba mtha' dag nag po che la 'dud/ /hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ gardzadza rā bai pa ra hi tā nuṣṭa sa twāṃ bha yaṃ kṛta/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ sgra sgrogs pas rnam par 'tshe ba'i gdug pa'i sems can 'jigs shing gzhan la phan mdzad pa/ /ghaṃ ghaṃ ghaṃ duṣṭa bṛndaṃ sra ba tsa na ra hi tānas twa pī ḍānsa dā s+huḥ/

ghaṃ ghaṃ ghaṃ zhes mi phan sgra zhing sems can rtag tu 'tshe byed gyur pa'i sdang pa'i tshogs rnams kun/ /cheṃ cheṃ cheṃ duṣṭa mānasaṃ pi ba ru dhi ra ba shaṃ ant+ra mā lā kṛ tīṅga/ chod chod chod cig gdug pa'i sha za khrag 'thung tshil dang rgyu ma'i phreng bas yan lag rnam brgyan pa/ /bheṃ bheṃ bheṃ sha tru ka yaṃ gi la sa ka laṃ taṃ na mo duṣṭaṃ da myaṃ/ zhig zhig zhig cig dgra bo'i tshogs rnams mtha' dag mid cing mid nas gdug pa 'dul mdzad phyag 'tshal lo/ /bhīṃ bhīṃ bhīṃ duṣṭa ra shīṃ ku ma ti ku ru ha laṃ kā ya bāktsitta pi ṭaṃ/ 'jigs 'jigs 'jigs mdzad lus ngag yid la rnam par 'tshe ba'i blo ngan sdang pa'i dpung tshogs 'khrugs pa rnams/ /moṃ moṃ moṃ kalpa bṛndhāṃ ku ki ka ha ma na sa ni gra haṃ sarba dṛṣṭiṃ/ rmongs rmongs rmongs pa'i kun rtog tshogs kyis nges par bcings pa'i yid can lta ba mtha' dag gang rnams dang / /kāṃ kāṃ kāṃ kriṣṇa bandhuṃ muḍha bi ma ti ma naṃ mā ra pakṣaṃ bi nā shaṃ ti a kṣa ā laṅkar/ kāṃ kāṃ kāṃ zhes nag po'i rtsa lag blun zhing rmongs pa'i blo can bdud kyi phyogs rnams nyams byed pa/ /kaṃ kaṃ kaṃ mā ra bhū bi ma gṛ ba da ha ba tsoṃ mā ra nā shaṃ na ma mi/ 'dar 'dar 'dar byed bdud kyi yul rnams thal bar rlog cing 'joms par dam bcas khyod la rab tu 'dud/ /nrī muṇḍa grānthi kaṇṭha bhu ba na ta la tsa laṃ ū na pañtsa sha bā yuṃ/ sa 'og g.yo ba'i rlung 'ching lnga bcur cig chad mgrin pa dang bcas mi mgo'i phreng ba rab tu 'phyang / /tr+ya kṣ+ya laṅkā ra bakt+raṃ tri bhu ba na ba si naṃ darshi tu sa twa rā shīṃ/ srid gsum gnas pa'i sems can phung po ma lus gzigs phyir spyan gsum gyis brgyan zhal gyi dkyil 'khor can/ /pāṃ pāṃ pāṃ buddha shāsnāṃ di na ni shi sa ta taṃ kṣe tra pā lañtsa kuryā ta/ skyong skyong skyong zhig zhing skyong khyod kyis nyin dang mtshan mo rtag tu sangs rgyas bstan pa skyong bar mdzod/

/raṃ raṃ raṃ dharma kā yaṃ ku sha la gha ṭa dza gta rakṣa bi kt+waṃ na mā mi/ bsrung bsrung bsrung zhing dge ba la sbyor 'gro ba bsrung zhing 'dzin mdzad chos kyi sku can khyod phyag 'tshal/ /suṃ suṃ suṃ kṛdashu bhā nāṃ swa sha pu si la kṛ taṃ bhā ba na bhirbi lā shāṃ/ bde bde bde mdzad dge ba la goms bde rgyas zhi dang grub pa'i dpal mdzad yangs pa'i mchog stsol ba/ /maṃ ga lyo pasd+ya yā nāṃ ma pi ku la gu ru pā de dza gansu pra kuryā tra/ rigs kyi bla ma'i zhabs sogs 'gro ba kun yang legs par rab tu bkra shis nye bar gnas mdzad cing / /kṣeṃ kṣeṃ kṣeṃ dhya ya mā nāṃ su ga ta ba tsa na dhṛksarb+ba ārya pa the ṣu/ 'tsho 'tsho 'tsho mdzad bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab klog cing 'jigs pa'i yid can 'phags pa'i lam gnas dang / /dzwa dzwa dzwa be sha nā nāṃ pa ra hista bi hi taṃ twaṃ dza gatpāṃ na mā mi/ phan dang mi phan skye bo skyong mdzad 'bar 'bar 'bar ba'i cha lugs can khyod gus pa'i phyag bgyi'o/ /no sa twānra he ma hā kā la a ra ti bi ma tī to bha yo pa dra be bhyaḥ kye kye nag po chen po dga' bral log pa'i blo can sems can rnams kyi nyer 'tshe'i 'jigs pa dang / /mṛ tyū ro go pa sargag bhya a ri a hi ta kṛnmā ra karm+mot+su ke bhyaḥ nad dang 'chi ba'i gnod pa phan bral dgra bo dang ni bdud kyi las la nye bar sbyor ba rnams/ /de bā yakṣa gra hā dyā pra ti gha ma na kri teḥduṣṭa nā gā dya karm+meḥ lha dang gnod sbyin gza' dang klu sogs gnod byed rab tu sdang pa'i yid can mtha' dag kyang / /shāntiṃ puṣṭiṃ tsa rakṣaṃ sha ra da sha di shi nai twaṃ gu rū sarb+ba kā laṃ/ khyod kyi dus dang phyogs bcu kun tu zhi zhing rgyas dang bsrung dang bskyab pa nyid du rab mdzod cig /buddha nāṃ dharm+ma pā laṃ sta ba da ra tsi taṃ bīdya ut+sā ha tsi tyaṃ/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dam chos skyong ba nye bar bstod pa'i tshig gang bkod pa'i spro ba brtson 'grus mtshor/

/dharm+mā di tye na tsant+yaṃ sa ra hi ta ma na sā sarb+ba sa twe bāñtsa/ sems can thams cad la ni phan pa'i yid can chos kyi nyin byed ces byas gzhan la phan pa'i blos/ /yatpu ṇyaṃ te na labhadhaṃ bi bi dha hi ta su khaṃ dzñā na twaṃ ma mā tsa/ bsod nams thob pa gang des sna tshogs phan dang bde ba'i rang bzhin bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi/ /sa twa she ṣā tri lo ke hi ta su kha ma ti ta twaṃ su labdha sa dās+huḥ smon pa'i gnas gang 'jig rten gsum na rtag tu phan bde'i de nyid ye shes legs par thob gyur cig /dwi bhu dza ma hā kā lasto traṃ sa māpta mi ti/ nag po chen po phyag gnyis pa'i bstod pa rdzogs so// //kṛ ti ri yaṃ shrī mat+sa dharm+ma di tya sd+ya bi ra pā dā nā mi ti/ ces pa 'di nyid gnas brtan dpal ldan dam pa chos kyi nyin byed kyis sbyar ba'o// //de yaṃ dharm+mo yaṃ pra ba ra ma hā yā nā ya mi na ma ma mā ta pi tṛ pūrb+baṅga ma sa ka la sa twa rā shi nutta ra yaṃ sa myaksaṃ bo dhau pha la prāpta ye ta/ sbyin par bya ba'i chos 'di rab mchog theg pa chen po'i tshul la gnas pa bdag gi pha mas gtso byas sems can thams cad mtha' dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi 'bras bu thob par gyur cig dpal sa skya lo tsa ba shākya'i dge slong rig sngags 'chang 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ me mkha' rgya mtsho dag pa'i lo gzhir bzhag nas lo drug cu skor brgyad dang nyag ma nyi shu bsres pa kun 'dul zhes bya ba me mo phag gi lo nag pa zla ba'i tshes gcig gi nyin/ mkhan chen chos rje'i bka' bzhin dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog tu dag par bsgyur ba'o/ /rgya skad ma dag pas da dung cung zad dpyad par bya rgyu yod do// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 sa lo chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ rdo rje 'jigs byed dang rdo rje nag po chen po phyag gnyis pa'i bstod pa/
